body:
## Purpose and current policy

Reclaim superseded GENERIC_X64 build intermediates for the authorized H700 then SM8550 firmware stages. This is the four-tree part of #493's broader immediate cleanup.

The maintainer's latest immediate cleanup request and D-INFRA-022 supersede generic fallback/history retention. Keep a large test artifact only for a named active or immediately queued test, with an owning issue and a release condition. Remove it when that test completes and its compact record is accepted. Retain inputs/environment, commands, logs, results, relevant frames, diagnosis and required source/licence material. Historical references are provenance, not an automatic live dependency.

Can this be done on the VM? No: host filesystem allocation, process ownership and preserved build inputs are host facts. These checks need no physical-device or personal-cloud action.

## Exact build-tree review

| Tree under `/workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/` | Frozen head |
| --- | --- |
| `m7-pixelelated-replacement09` | `cf511ce79b83cba7fea8b14cfa3d04fb13e4b4fb` |
| `m7-pixelelated-replacement10` | `d6e8390c93bed87efe2dcc23cd402a271cacd1c7` |
| `m7-pixelelated-replacement12` | `55d8ee8f75965a560f75d187e34c9beaa93133f1` |
| `m7-pixelelated-replacement14` | `7afa9efcfc0c1ce4b89774b38878fc1b9a9063d2` |

All four have independent compact custody with 14,489 content objects and four 568-root source inventories. Current heads, expected generated diff, retained sources and metadata have been checked again. Potential net recovery is 464,468,140,032 bytes (432.57 GiB), after charging the full preservation store.

The earlier replacement12 hold is superseded by D-INFRA-022. Its 14 overlay source links belong to completed QA16 (failed) and QA17 (passed); both have terminal results and guest/process cleanup. The exact source commit/path, tracked diff, input inventory and custody remain, so old source links are historical inputs rather than live consumers. This does not change their original test results. Use `tools/fork-worktree remove` for each whole tree and preserve a retirement receipt.

Keep the active H700 build, current qualified release inputs and required source/licence/cache records outside this exact scope. There is no generic permanent fallback hold for other historical trees; #493 separately classifies them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Exact tree/branch/head, dirty diff, allocation, source and historical references are recorded in the accepted review and current prepared plan.
- [x] Independent verification accepts all 14,489 preservation objects and required source inventories; preservation cost is charged against potential recovery.
- [x] Completed QA16/QA17 source links are mapped to exact retained source and terminal evidence under the revised policy.
- [x] The four worktrees are covered by the administrator snapshot and current host/container checks; their receipts resolve active-use dependencies before removal.
- [x] The standard helper removed all four exact worktrees; watched terminal results and post-action verification establish absence, actual recovery and preserved inputs.

## Completed cleanup — 2026-10-07 06:38 UTC

The explicitly authorized batch removed 850 VM/firmware files, 30 paths holding ten extracted OS copies, and replacement09/10/12/14 through tools/fork-worktree. All 884 target paths are absent and the four trees are unregistered. Measured recovery: **2,117,325,385,728 bytes**; final verified availability: **2,290,757,619,712 bytes**. Verification rehashed **51,070 compact records**, **14,489 source-custody objects** and all **five temporary test-required firmware files**. Four zero result channels, eight unchanged input seals and actual process exits are accepted. There are415 retirement markers beside retained records.

**Administrator scope limitation, #498:** the root snapshot read all processes without access errors, but its directory-only scope omitted14 loose historical firmware files directly in the image-store root. Those files were explicitly authorized and passed hash, unprivileged process-reference, container and external-reference checks. Do not claim root-only coverage for them. Original sealed receipts remain historical; a separate scope-gap record identifies every omitted path. The corrected executor refuses any target outside the administrator roots, with eight isolated controls passing. This later correction does not retroactively validate the old snapshot scope.

The four reviewed worktrees and all completed QA disks were inside the administrator scope. The administrator snapshot plus current visible references and process birth times found no active dependency on these targets; no newly protected process was accepted. Source links from completed QA runs are preserved as historical commit/path records rather than keeping build output alive.

Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-storage-retention/completed/`, full owner `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-broad-cleanup-01`. No cleanup replay or wider deletion is inferred.

## Current firmware work — #492

H700 aarch64 firmware started at06:38:36 from frozen `43d0bc3bf47fd858ba8d5c55fbdf52535a0db2aa`, following accepted arm05. The guarded swap helper ran before the watcher and restored the full8GiB swap reserve; capacity and host preflight passed. Actual pinned container, checkout/source-cache mounts and watcher PIDs are verified. Owner: `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-h700-firmware-01`; run `20261007T063836Z-bd9973f1`. Compiler progress is actively supervised. Raw/update equality, installed architecture/identity and independent artifact acceptance follow completion. SM8550 remains next after verified H700 artifacts. No device flashing, physical smoke or RC designation is claimed.
